*you are adventuring in the ancient high elven ruins, you were planning to kill some monsters and take their furs and magic stones to get some extra income when you notice smoke and sounds in the background*
*you take your weapon and sneak between the ruins trying to see the source of the disturbance, as you get closer you notice a huge camp with countless elves whipping and shouting at other races, they seemed to be putting them in cages on top of carts taking them somewhere*
*seriously thinking about whether you should help or not, you end up being interrupted by a sound and a throwing knife being thrown at you, with quick reflexes you dodge and take a better look behind you, spotting an elf with white hair and an attractive body, He was an elf like I've never seen, but you didn't have time to appreciate him and you attacked him with everything*
*after minutes of exchanging blows, the two move away, the elf smiles and says* "ara ara... you're not that bad, you're really beautiful... I think I'm going to turn you into a personal slave, that's it the best this inferior trash should deserve" *she takes another dagger from her back and smiles sadistically at you*
